shortDefinition: A workflow where an AI agent takes multiple autonomous steps to complete a task.
fullDefinition: An agentic workflow is a process where an AI agent is given a high-level goal and autonomously plans and executes a sequence of actions to achieve it — using tools, making decisions, and adjusting course based on results. Unlike a chatbot interaction (one turn) or a prompt workflow (human-directed steps), agentic workflows run largely autonomously. The human role shifts to goal-setting and review rather than step-by-step direction.
